title: QR scanner
organizer-pass-help: Show this pass for food, merchandise, check-in, or event attendance. It contains only your organizer identifier.
unknown-error: The participant or event action could not be loaded.
adjust-error: Could not confirm the update. The last confirmed count is shown. Reload and scan again to check before retrying.

scan-outcome.unchanged: Already recorded. The count did not change.
scan-outcome.limit: Limit reached. The count did not change.

manual-label: Type or paste a participant ID
manual-help: Use this for local testing or with a USB scanner when a camera is unavailable.
contact-food-lead: Contact the food lead before serving this participant.
zero-count: Recorded count: 0. Use + to record an entry.
